limitations: Controller has not been run, even with --help.
No actual child-exit, process-group-kill, timeout, or RSS integration test has been executed; Root must review source and observed actual outcome.
Darwin MaxRSS must be positive and at most 256 MiB; an observed normal completion after 300 seconds fails even when the completion select wins a timer race.
Final OS MaxRSS is an observed gate, not an enforced process memory cap; it has no GPU attribution.
Controller and worker are directly invoked by absolute path; caller pin checks are not kernel execution attestation.
mechanics: Six pure synthetic tests cover stdout overflow without raw retention, stderr bounded private prefix and full hash, regular-file size/hash checks and symlink rejection, Project/Fit plan headers and separate exclusive paths, metadata-only Darwin directory fsync, and exact exclusive final metadata byte accounting. No test calls run/exec/Start or a corpus API.
